faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for GSVM Medical College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 3 December 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GSVM Medical College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Research Scientist-I, 1 Research Scientist-II.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GSVM Medical College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 3 December 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Research Scientist-I: maximum 35 years; Research Scientist-II: below 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 56000 + HRA for Research Scientist-I, 67000 + HRA for Research Scientist-II.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Research Scientist-I: MBBS (MCI recognised) or BE/B.Tech in Bio Technology or First class Master's in Life Sciences or Second Class M.Sc plus Ph.D. Research Scientist-II: MD/MS/DNB with 5 years R&D/teaching experience, or PG diploma with 6 years, or MBBS with 8 years, or BDS/B.V.Sc & AH with 9 years, or First class Master's with 8 years, or Second Class M.Sc + Ph.D with 8 years experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No travel allowance will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Posts are filled on contract basis for the MRU Lab funded by the Department of Health Research, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MRU Lab, G.S.V.M. Medical College, Kanpur.
